# Noviq Solutions

> Global software and AI engineering company. We build custom AI solutions, ERP and CRM systems, SaaS platforms, cloud infrastructure, and web & mobile applications for ambitious businesses. Fully bilingual (English & Arabic) with 480+ projects delivered across 32 countries since 2014.

## What we do

- **AI Solutions**: Custom AI models, LLM integrations, chatbots, NLP, computer vision, and intelligent automation (Python, TensorFlow, PyTorch, OpenAI).
- **Custom Software**: Bespoke systems engineered around client workflows, from replacing spreadsheets to full legacy modernization.
- **ERP Systems**: Unified operations platforms connecting finance, inventory, procurement, and HR.
- **CRM Platforms**: Sales and support tooling with lead management, pipelines, and ticketing.
- **Cloud Solutions**: Resilient, auto-scaling infrastructure across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud with DevOps and Kubernetes.
- **SaaS Development**: Multi-tenant products with subscriptions, billing, and analytics.
- **Web & Mobile Apps**: React/Next.js web applications and native-feel iOS/Android apps from a single codebase.
- **API Development & Integrations**: REST/GraphQL APIs, payment gateways, WhatsApp/SMS integrations.
- **Business Automation & Digital Transformation**: Workflow automation and end-to-end modernization strategy.

## Key facts

- Founded: 2014 (12+ years of experience)
- Projects delivered: 480+
- Countries served: 32
- Enterprise clients: 140+
- Offices: San Francisco, London, Singapore
- Languages: English and Arabic (full RTL support and Arabic-speaking AI assistant)
- Typical timelines: landing pages 2-4 weeks; web/mobile MVP 6-12 weeks; full ERP/CRM 3-6 months
- Pricing: Starter, Growth, and Enterprise plans; milestone-based payments
- Security: encryption, penetration testing, NDAs, full source-code ownership on delivery
- Support: SLAs up to 24/7 with 99.9% uptime

## Industries

Healthcare (HIPAA-compliant platforms), Finance & FinTech (4M+ daily transactions processed), Manufacturing, Education, Real Estate, Retail & E-commerce, Government, Logistics.

## Notable case studies

- Predictive Ops for a Logistics Network: demand-forecasting engine that cut idle fleet time by 31% across six countries.
- Unified Ledger for a Digital Bank: real-time reconciliation processing 4M+ transactions daily.
- Patient Intelligence Suite: HIPAA-compliant platform connecting 200+ clinics on one care record.
- Omnichannel Commerce Engine: inventory and CRM unification behind a single storefront.
